'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Donbas (2022–present)|Battle of Donbas]]
***[[Russia]] uses its [[T-14 Armata]] [[main battle tank]]s in combat against [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] for the first time. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-new-t-14-armata-battle-tank-debuts-ukraine-ria-2023-04-25/ (Reuters)]
**[[China and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Paramount leader|Chinese leader]] [[Xi Jinping]] calls [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]], with both countries announcing the dispatch of representatives to establish a diplomatic presence after the call. [https://www.npr.org/2023/04/26/1164668179/xi-putin-summit-zelenskyy-china-russia-ukraine (NPR)]
*[[Naxalite–Maoist insurgency]]
**[[2023 Dantewada bombing]]
***Ten policemen and a [[civilian]] driver are killed when a bomb planted by suspected [[Communist Party of India (Maoist)|Maoist militants]] [[explode]]s in [[Dantewada district]], [[Chhattisgarh]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/ten-policemen-driver-killed-central-india-blast-maoists-suspected-police-2023-04-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iran]]ian [[ayatollah]] and [[Assembly of Experts]] member [[Abbas-Ali Soleimani]] is [[assassination|assassinated]] in a shooting at a bank in [[Babolsar]], [[Mazandaran province]]. The perpetrator, a security guard at the bank, has been arrested by police. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-65398982 (BBC News)]
*Six Iranian demonstrators are injured in clashes in [[Fanuj]], [[Sistan and Baluchistan province]], after a teenager was killed when his motorcycle collided with a police car. [https://www.rferl.org/amp/iran-clashes-teen-dies-police/32380786.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Proposed acquisition of Activision Blizzard by Microsoft]]
**The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Competition and Markets Authority]] blocks [[Microsoft]]'s $68.7bn (£55bn) acquisition of [[Activision Blizzard]], saying that the deal will leave [[video game]]rs with less choice and will reduce innovation. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-65378617 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022–2023 mpox outbreak]]
**[[Pakistan]] reports their first case of [[mpox]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/26/pakistan-confirms-its-first-case-of-mpox (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Singapore]]
**[[Singapore]] [[executes]] [[Tangaraju Suppiah]] for plotting to [[illegal drug trade|smuggle]] 1 kilogram of [[cannabis]] into the country. His execution, the country's first this year, drew significant pleas for clemency, including from the [[United Nations]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-65395390 (BBC News)]
*[[Salvadoran gang crackdown (2022–present)|Salvadoran gang crackdown]]
**[[El Salvador]] opens a [[trial]] against former [[President of El Salvador|president]] [[Mauricio Funes]] for initiating a [[2012–2014 Salvadoran gang truce|truce with street gangs]] during his presidency. Funes, who is currently living in [[Nicaragua]], [[Trial in absentia|will not attend the trial]]. [https://apnews.com/article/el-salvador-mauricio-funes-gang-truce-d5688b5337cc2c64f73cccbbe020d722 (AP)]
*A [[Brazil|Brazilian]] judge orders a temporary shutdown of [[social media]] [[mobile app|app]] [[Telegram (software)|Telegram]] over its failure to provide information on [[Neo-Nazi]] chat groups to the [[Federal Police of Brazil]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-telegram-suspension-social-media-school-violence-d72acaacd3c1b4d07c2c4fcb094f4ce6 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 United States debt-ceiling crisis]]
**By a vote of 217–215, the [[United States House of Representatives]] passes a bill that would raise the [[United States debt ceiling]] by [[$]]1.5 trillion in exchange for spending restrictions. [https://apnews.com/article/speaker-mccarthy-debt-biden-republicans-d4995f10a26d6c8bfa89a2bbfd1de93c (AP)]
*[[English Channel migrant crossings (2018–present)|English Channel migrant crossings]]
**The [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom]] passes the [[Illegal Migration Bill]] by a vote of 289–230 despite opposition from some members of the ruling [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/65397710 (BBC News)]
*[[Zooey Zephyr]], the first openly [[transgender]] member of the [[Montana House of Representatives]], is censured by the [[Montana Republican Party|Republican]]-led chamber on a party-line vote following her protest of [[anti-transgender]] legislation. Zephyr will be barred from debate until the May legislative session. [https://www.kxlh.com/news/68th-session/montana-house-votes-to-ban-transgender-representative-from-the-house-floor (KXLH-TV)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 NBA playoffs]]
**In [[basketball]], the eight seed [[2022–23 Miami Heat season|Miami Heat]] defeat the [[2022–23 Milwaukee Bucks season|Milwaukee Bucks]], who held the best record of the season at 58–24, in five games. The loss was widely described as one of the greatest upsets in NBA history. [https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/36300795/jimmy-butler-heat-stun-bucks-ot-oust-top-seeded-milwaukee (ESPN)]
